maddeler.e:
استقطعن (form X)
# اِسْتَقْطَعْنَ (istaqṭaʕna) /is.taq.tˤaʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
# اُسْتُقْطِعْنَ (ustuqṭiʕna) /us.tuq.tˤiʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
# اِسْتَقْطِعْنَ (istaqṭiʕna) /is.taq.tˤiʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
